## Why This Is Asked
Assess DR design, cross-region provisioning, test orchestration, metric collection, and failover control under real-world constraints.

## Key Concepts
- Cross-region ARM deployments and idempotent templates
- Synthetic load testing and end-to-end validation
- RTO/RPO measurement and Azure Monitor integration
- Approval gates and automated rollback
- Safe data seeding and tenant isolation

## Code Example

```yaml
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
stages:
- stage: DRProvision
  jobs:
  - job: DeployRegions
    steps:
      - task: AzureCLI@2
        inputs:
          scriptType: bash
          scriptLocation: inlineScript
          inlineScript: |
            az group create -n dr-rg-a -l eastus
            az group create -n dr-rg-b -l westus
- stage: DeployTests
  dependsOn: DRProvision
  jobs:
  - job: DeployRegionA
    steps:
      - script: echo Deploy to Region A
  - job: DeployRegionB
    steps:
      - script: echo Deploy to Region B
```

- What metrics and alerts would you configure to ensure SLA compliance and quick rollback?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests candidates' ability to design complex, real-world deployments spanning multiple regions, tenants, and policy controls, including traffic management, drift detection, automated rollback, and observability.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant namespaces in AKS
- Blue/green rollout strategies across primary and DR clusters
- Argo Rollouts or Istio for traffic shifting
- Azure Policy + OPA gating mechanisms
- Per-tenant feature flags via App Configuration
- Drift checks against ARM templates
- Automated rollback and Azure Monitor Logs integration

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  none

pr: none

resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: templates
      type: git
      name: $(azureDevOpsOrg)/pipeline-templates
      ref: main

variables:
  - group: tenant-config
  - name: aksPrimaryCluster
    value: "aks-primary-weu"
  - name: aksDrCluster
    value: "aks-dr-neu"
  - name: appConfigName
    value: "appconfig-$(env)"

stages:
  - stage: Validate_Templates
    displayName: "Validate ARM Templates"
    jobs:
      - job: Drift_Check
        displayName: "Per-Tenant Drift Detection"
        steps:
          - task: AzureResourceManagerTemplateDeployment@3
            displayName: "Validate ARM Template Syntax"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroupName: $(tenantResourceGroup)
              location: $(location)
              csmFile: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/arm/tenant-template.json
              overrideParameters: "-tenantId $(tenantId)"
              deploymentMode: Validation
          - script: |
              echo "Checking drift against baseline..."
              az resource group show --name $(tenantResourceGroup) \
                --query "properties.templateValidationResults" || true
            displayName: "Detect Configuration Drift"

  - stage: Build_Tenant_Artifacts
    displayName: "Build Container Images"
    jobs:
      - job: Build_and_Push
        displayName: "Build per-Tenant Image"
        steps:
          - task: Docker@2
            displayName: "Build API Image"
            inputs:
              command: build
              dockerfile: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Dockerfile
              arguments: |
                --build-arg TENANT_ID=$(tenantId)
                --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$(Build.BuildNumber)
              imageName: "$(containerRegistry)/tenant-api-$(tenantId):$(Build.BuildNumber)"
          - task: Docker@2
            displayName: "Push to ACR"
            inputs:
              command: push
              containerRegistry: $(containerRegistry)
              imageName: "$(containerRegistry)/tenant-api-$(tenantId):$(Build.BuildNumber)"

  - stage: Deploy_Primary_Cluster
    displayName: "Deploy to Primary (WEU)"
    dependsOn: [Build_Tenant_Artifacts, Validate_Templates]
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_To_Primary
        displayName: "Deploy with Argo Rollout"
        environment: "aks-primary-$(tenantId)"
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - checkout: self
                - task: KubernetesManifest@0
                  displayName: "Apply Argo Rollout CRD"
                  inputs:
                    action: create
                    kubernetesServiceConnection: $(aksPrimaryConnection)
                    namespace: "tenant-$(tenantId)"
                    manifests: |
                      $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/k8s/rollout.yaml
                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  displayName: "Pause Rollout at 30%"
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    scriptType: bash
                    scriptLocation: inlineScript
                    inlineScript: |
                      kubectl argo rollouts pause tenant-api \
                        -n tenant-$(tenantId) \
                        --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig
                - task: AzurePolicy@0
                  displayName: "Azure Policy Compliance Check"
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    definitionId: "/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyDefinitions/tenant-config-policy"
                    assignmentId: "/subscriptions/$(subId)/resourceGroups/$(tenantResourceGroup)/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyAssignments/tenant-policy"
                - bash: |
                    curl -s https://opa-endpoint:8181/v1/data/tenant/promotion \
                      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
                      -d @/dev/stdin <<< '{"input": {"tenant": "$(tenantId)", "env": "$(env)"}}'
                  name: opa_gate_check
                  displayName: "OPA Policy Gate"

  - stage: Traffic_Shift_30_70
    displayName: "Traffic Shift 30/70"
    dependsOn: Deploy_Primary_Cluster
    condition: succeeded('opa_gate_check')
    jobs:
      - job: Shift_Traffic
        steps:
          - bash: |
              kubectl argo rollouts set-weight tenant-api 30 \
                -n tenant-$(tenantId) \
                --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig
            displayName: "Set Traffic to 30/70"
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            displayName: "Monitor Health Metrics"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroup: $(tenantResourceGroup)
              alertRules:
                - alertName: "HighErrorRate"
                  expression: "requests_error_rate > 0.05"
                  severity: warning
          - bash: |
              sleep 300
              echo "Monitoring for 5 minutes before proceeding..."
            displayName: "Smoke Test Period"

  - stage: Traffic_Shift_100
    displayName: "Full Promotion 100%"
    dependsOn: Traffic_Shift_30_70
    jobs:
      - job: Full_Promotion
        steps:
          - bash: |
              kubectl argo rollouts set-weight tenant-api 100 \
                -n tenant-$(tenantId) \
                --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig
              kubectl argo rollouts promote tenant-api \
                -n tenant-$(tenantId)
            displayName: "Promote to 100% Traffic"

  - stage: Deploy_DR_Cluster
    displayName: "Deploy to DR (NEU)"
    dependsOn: Traffic_Shift_100
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_To_DR
        displayName: "DR Cluster Sync"
        environment: "aks-dr-$(tenantId)"
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - bash: |
                    kubectl argo rollouts set-weight tenant-api 0 \
                      -n tenant-$(tenantId) \
                      --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig-dr
                    kubectl apply -f $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/k8s/rollout.yaml \
                      --namespace tenant-$(tenantId) \
                      --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig-dr
                  displayName: "Initialize DR with Zero Traffic"

  - stage: Auto_Rollback_Check
    displayName: "Rollback Monitoring"
    dependsOn:
      - Traffic_Shift_30_70
      - Traffic_Shift_100
    jobs:
      - job: Monitor_And_Rollback
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: "Configure Rollback Triggers"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: bash
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor metrics alert create \
                  --name "rollback-$(tenantId)" \
                  --resource-group $(tenantResourceGroup) \
                  --condition "count > 10 where errorCode >= 500" \
                  --action apiUrl=https://v3.rollouts.azrefficient.net/api/rollback \
                    -n "aut rollback-hook"
          - bash: |
              kubectl argo rollouts get rollout tenant-api \
                -n tenant-$(tenantId) -w &
              ROLLOUT_PID=$!
              sleep 600
              if ps -p $ROLLOUT_PID > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                kubectl argo rollouts abort tenant-api \
                  -n tenant-$(tenantId)
                echo "Auto-rollback triggered due to degraded health"
              fi
            displayName: "Health-Based Rollback Monitor"

  - stage: Log_To_Monitor
    displayName: "Azure Monitor Logging"
    dependsOn: [Deploy_Primary_Cluster, Traffic_Shift_30_70, Traffic_Shift_100, Deploy_DR_Cluster]
    jobs:
      - job: Publish_Logs
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: "Send Pipeline Metrics to Log Analytics"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: bash
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor log-analytics query \
                  --workspace $(logAnalyticsWorkspace) \
                  --analytics-query "\
                    PipelineLogs | where PipelineName == '$(PipelineName)' \
                    and TenantId == '$(tenantId)' | summarize \
                    count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Status"
          - task: PublishToAzureMonitorLogs@1
            displayName: "Export Full Pipeline Logs"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              ResourceGroup: $(tenantResourceGroup)
              logs:
                - name: TenantDeploymentLogs
                  type: Generic
                  source: pipeline

## Failure Modes and Guardrails

| Failure Mode | Detection | Guardrail |
|--------------|-----------|-----------|
| ARM template drift | Azure Resource Manager validation | Block deployment until reconciled |
| Policy non-compliance | Azure Policy evaluation | OPA gate prevents promotion |
| Traffic shift error rate spike | Log Analytics alert | Auto-rollback via Argo Rollouts |
| DR cluster sync failure | Health endpoint check | Fail deployment, notify via Teams |
| Feature flag mismatch | App Config sync validation | Pause rollout, require manual override |
| Namespace quota exceeded | AKS resource metrics | Pre-deployment quota check |

## Required Integrations

1. **Azure App Configuration**: Store per-tenant feature flags with key vault references for secrets
2. **Azure Container Registry**: Host per-tenant container images with tags
3. **Azure Monitor / Application Insights**: End-to-end observability and alerting
4. **Argo Rollouts**: Kubernetes-native progressive delivery with automated rollback
5. **OPA Gatekeeper**: Policy enforcement for tenant isolation and resource limits
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates the candidate's ability to design end-to-end tenant onboarding, isolation, governance, and observability in Azure DevOps at production scale.

## Key Concepts
- Parameterized YAML templates and conditional deployment
- Per-tenant resource isolation: Resource Group, App Service plan, deployment slot
- App Configuration and Key Vault integration
- Database seeding and tenant-specific tests in isolated environments
- Policy gates and drift detection
- Rollback strategy and per-tenant auditing to Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger: none

parameters:
  - name: tenantId
    type: string
    displayName: 'Tenant ID'
  - name: tenantDomain
    type: string
    displayName: 'Tenant Domain'

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-spn'
  subscriptionId: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID)'
  resourceGroupName: 'rg-$(tenantId)'
  appServicePlanName: 'asp-$(tenantId)'
  appServiceName: 'api-$(tenantId)'
  appConfigName: 'appconfig-$(tenantId)'
  keyVaultName: 'kv-shared-01'
  databaseServerName: 'sql-$(tenantId)'
  databaseName: 'db-$(tenantId)'

stages:
  - stage: Provision
    displayName: 'Provision Tenant Resources'
    jobs:
      - job: ProvisionResources
        displayName: 'Provision Infrastructure'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create Resource Group'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group create --name $(resourceGroupName) --location eastus
                az configure --defaults group=$(resourceGroupName)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Service Plan'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az appservice plan create --name $(appServicePlanName) --sku S1 --is-linux

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Service with Deployment Slot'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az webapp create --name $(appServiceName) --plan $(appServicePlanName) --runtime 'NODE|18-lts'
                az webapp deployment slot create --name $(appServiceName) --slot staging

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create SQL Database'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az sql server create --name $(databaseServerName) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --location eastus
                az sql db create --name $(databaseName) --server $(databaseServerName) --service-tier Basic

  - stage: Configure
    displayName: 'Configure Tenant'
    dependsOn: Provision
    jobs:
      - job: LoadConfiguration
        displayName: 'Load Settings and Secrets'
        steps:
          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Fetch Tenant Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Configure App Settings'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az webapp config appsettings set --name $(appServiceName) --slot staging --settings \
                  TENANT_ID=$(tenantId) \
                  TENANT_DOMAIN=$(tenantDomain) \
                  DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING='Server=tcp:$(databaseServerName).database.windows.net,1433;Database=$(databaseName);User ID=$(keyVaultTenantUser);Password=$(keyVaultTenantPassword);Encrypt=true;'

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Seed Database'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                sqlcmd -S $(databaseServerName).database.windows.net -d $(databaseName) -U $(keyVaultTenantUser) -P $(keyVaultTenantPassword) -i seed-tenant.sql

  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: 'Deploy to Staging'
    dependsOn: Configure
    jobs:
      - job: DeployApplication
        displayName: 'Deploy to Staging Slot'
        steps:
          - task: AzureWebApp@1
            displayName: 'Deploy to Staging Slot'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              appType: 'webApp'
              appName: $(appServiceName)
              deployToSlotOrASE: true
              resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              slotName: 'staging'

  - stage: Test
    displayName: 'Run Tests'
    dependsOn: Deploy
    jobs:
      - job: RunTests
        displayName: 'Execute Tenant Tests'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Unit Tests'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                npm test -- --tenantId=$(tenantId) --environment=staging

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Integration Tests'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                npm run test:integration -- --tenantId=$(tenantId) --environment=staging

  - stage: GateAndPolicy
    displayName: 'Policy Gates & Drift Check'
    dependsOn: Test
    jobs:
      - job: PolicyCheck
        displayName: 'Verify Policy Compliance'
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicy@0
            displayName: 'Check Azure Policy Compliance'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              definitionId: '/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyDefinitions/...' 

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Drift Detection'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az deployment group show --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --name initial-deployment
                # Compare current state with desired state

  - stage: Promote
    displayName: 'Promote to Production'
    dependsOn: GateAndPolicy
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - job: SwapSlots
        displayName: 'Swap Staging to Production'
        steps:
          - task: AzureAppServiceManage@0
            displayName: 'Swap Staging to Production'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              Action: 'Swap Slots'
              WebAppName: $(appServiceName)
              ResourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              SourceSlot: 'staging'

  - stage: Audit
    displayName: 'Audit & Logging'
    dependsOn: Promote
    jobs:
      - job: LogAuditTrail
        displayName: 'Send Audit Logs to Azure Monitor'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Log Tenant Onboarding'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor app-insights trace show \
                  --location eastus \
                  --query "[?operationName == 'tenant-onboarding']"

                # Send custom event
                az monitor app-insights events show --app $(appInsightsName) --type customEvents
```

This YAML pipeline demonstrates a complete tenant onboarding workflow with infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, testing, policy enforcement, and production deployment with full audit logging capabilities.
